title: Learning in Strategic Queuing with Geometric Recharge: From Bandits to Systems
abstract: arXiv:2610.19179v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study packet routing in queuing systems where queues act as selfish, myopic agents that use no-regret learning algorithms to select servers with unknown service rates. To model the small buffers used in data centers, we assume that each server has a single-packet buffer. Even such a tiny buffer already captures the features of buffering: routers can exploit multiple servers while accepted packets remain in service, but packets can occupy servers for multiple rounds, complicating future service and learning.   We first analyze a single queue routing packets to $m$ buffered servers with service rates $\mu_1, \dots, \mu_m$. This setting is equivalent to an instance of the recharging bandits problem with geometric recharge. We prove that any no-regret learner achieves a long-run average throughput of at least the Hamacher sum of the server rates, and that this bound is tight. translated_title: 几何充能下策略性排队中的学习：从老虎机到系统
translated_abstract: 我们研究排队系统中的数据包路由问题，其中队列扮演自私、短视的智能体角色，使用无悔学习算法来选择具有未知服务速率的服务器。为了对数据中心中使用的小缓冲区进行建模，我们假设每个服务器都有一个单数据包缓冲区。即使是如此微小的缓冲区也已经捕捉到了缓冲的关键特性：路由器可以在被接受的数据包仍处于服务中时利用多个服务器，但数据包可能会占用服务器多个回合，从而使未来的服务和学习变得复杂。我们首先分析将数据包路由到 $m$ 个服务速率分别为 $\mu_1, \dots, \mu_m$ 的缓冲服务器的单个队列。该设置等价于几何充能的再充能老虎机问题的一个实例。我们证明，任何无悔学习者都能实现至少等于服务器速率的 Hamacher 和的长期平均吞吐量，且该界是紧的。因此，单个无悔队列是稳定的当且仅当……
tldr: 该论文将具有单数据包缓冲区的策略性排队问题与几何充能老虎机问题建立等价关系，并证明任何无悔学习队列都能达到至少等于服务器速率 Hamacher 和的长期平均吞吐量，且该界是紧的。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes an equivalence between strategic queuing with single-packet buffers and the geometric recharging bandits problem, proving that any no-regret queue achieves a long-run average throughput of at least the Hamacher sum of the server rates, and that this bound is tight.
